en.headline: New World Development weighs rights issue of up to HK$25 billion
en.dek: The developer, whose shares were halted Friday, is considering a rights issue after people familiar with the matter said Bain Capital decided against investing; the Cheng family plans to take part.
body: New World Development is considering a rights issue that could raise as much as HK$25 billion to strengthen its finances, according to people familiar with the situation.

Bloomberg News reported that Bain Capital had explored a potential investment but decided against it after failing to agree on terms. The controlling Cheng family intends to participate in the rights issue and inject fresh capital, the people said.

Trading in the company's shares and some bonds was suspended from 9 am Friday pending an announcement on inside information. The firm reported a large loss in its last fiscal year amid the property downturn.

zh.headline: 新世界發展考慮供股集資最高250億元
zh.dek: 股份周五停牌的發展商正考慮供股，據知情人士稱貝恩資本決定不投資；鄭氏家族計劃參與。
body: 據知情人士透露，新世界發展正考慮進行供股，集資金額最高可達250億港元，以加強財務狀況。
彭博新聞報道，貝恩資本曾探討潛在投資，但因未能就條款達成協議而決定不參與。控制股東鄭氏家族有意參與供股並注入新資金。
公司股份及部分債券由周五上午9時起暫停交易，待公布內幕消息。公司上個財政年度錄得重大虧損，受地產低迷影響。
